Hero.text: ARTEX Global Markets, an entity of ARTEX Corporate, provides the market with the world's very first regulated Art Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF).

attributes.bloc_1_text: ARTEX's mission is to provide a regulated, liquid and transparent art trading facility that would be accessible to anyone interested in trading art shares.
attributes.bloc_2_text: ARTEX enables investors to invest in art shares with a starting nominal value of 100 USD a share. By using fractionalisation and providing liquidity, we are allowing a broader range of investors to benefit from art’s proven store of value and portfolio diversification advantages.
